scope: Dry-run-only diagnostic, one instrumented source file and two integration test files. No mutant execution, full shard pass, hardware use or external adoption is claimed.
finding: A checkout-only venv causes EISDIR while copying its directory symlink. Excluding it from the sandbox reproduces the original ENOENT. Exclusion plus uv sync in buildCommand prepares a sandbox-local locked environment before the dry run.
